g.text: error patterns detected on the lecture frame 1101 0011 0100 (12 bits, 4095 non-zero error patterns)

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #9aa5b1

g.text: DETECTED = every error of that type is caught | PARTLY = only some | BLIND = none

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #222831

g.text: Parity sees only HOW MANY bits flipped: an even number of flips cancels out.
